data.narrative: The student identified three distinct performance bottlenecks using runtime profiling tools rather than code scanning: unclosed connection pool leaks on error branches (fixed via try/finally), N+1 query lazy loading (fixed via explicit LEFT JOIN eager loading), and ReDoS CPU spikes on long repeating URLs (fixed via linear URL parser).

dimension_scores.observation: Used APM and profiling tools to systematically observe memory allocation and CPU sample execution.
dimension_scores.evidence: Selected APM broad inspection strategy to baseline p95/p99 latency percentiles and isolate thermal hotspots.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed SQL query logs to discover ORM N+1 lazy loading regression.
dimension_scores.evidence: Observed 51 queries generated for GET /links (1 list query + 50 individual analytics queries).

dimension_scores.observation: Reproduced ReDoS CPU spike deterministically using repeating URL character payloads.
dimension_scores.evidence: Sent long URL payload triggering 100% single-core CPU utilization and 47-second execution bottleneck.

dimension_scores.observation: Articulated clear technical rationale for tool-assisted performance profiling vs static code inspection.
dimension_scores.evidence: Explained how dependency default changes evade static code analysis but are immediately exposed in query logs.

dimension_scores.observation: Diagnosed root cause for connection pool leaks, ORM defaults, and regular expression exponential backtracking.
dimension_scores.evidence: Fixed connection leaks with try/finally, replaced N+1 with LEFT JOIN, and replaced regex with linear URL parser.

dimension_scores.observation: Captured complete diagnostic logs, heap metrics, SQL log metrics, and flamegraph evidence.

strengths: Demonstrated exceptional proficiency with runtime profiling tools by isolating memory leaks, N+1 query traps, and ReDoS CPU spikes.
Applied defense-in-depth fixes including try/finally connection release, single SQL joins, and linear URL parsing.
data.recommendation: Carry runtime profiling and evidence-driven triage into multi-layer incident response in Module 05.

public_evidence.student_action: Diagnosed and resolved memory leak, N+1 queries, and ReDoS CPU spike using runtime profilers.
public_evidence.technical_detail: POST /links, GET /api/admin/links, try/finally connection release, SQL LEFT JOIN eager loading, linear URL parser
public_evidence.proof: RSS delta < 5MB across 2000 requests, SQL queries reduced from 51 to 1, latency dropped from 47,000ms to < 5ms
public_evidence.ability: Application performance profiling, memory leak detection, and query optimization
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves mastery over production performance profiling, database query optimization, and ReDoS mitigation.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Used memory tracking, SQL query logging, and CPU flamegraphs to fix 3 performance bugs.
